 Mallorca weather for Thursday, October 29 - A rainy end to the tourism season
 Temperatures expected to gradually fall over the coming days
 Cloud could be quite heavy at times on Thursday. | Photo: David Arquimbau Sintes
 Andrew Ede Palma 28/10/2026 15:14 
 F T W M 
 0 Follow 
 Add Majorca Daily Bulletin on Google 
 Weather stations across Mallorca are indicating a high probability of rain on Thursday. There may well be some heavy cloud in areas, interspersed by sunny periods. Temperatures are expected to remain slightly above average.
 The outlook is for rain into next week - up to Tuesday at least - and for temperatures to begin to fall and drop below 20C next week. The weekend could be quite windy.
 At present, though, the rain looks likely to be in the form of occasional, light showers. There are no alerts in place.
 Forecast for Thursday as of Wednesday 3pm (UV rating 3):
 Alcudia (15C) 23C, gentle northwest breeze easing to calm; humidity 65%. Three-day forecast - Fri: 23, Sat: 23, Sun: 22.
 Andratx (14C) 23C, gentle west breeze easing to calm; humidity 65%. Fri: 23, Sat: 22, Sun: 22.
 Binissalem (11C) 23C, light west breeze veering northwest; humidity 60%. Fri: 23, Sat: 21, Sun: 22.
 Palma (13C) 24C, light southwest breeze veering northwest; humidity 55%. Fri: 24, Sat: 22, Sun: 23.
 Pollença (14C) 24C, gentle west breeze easing to calm; humidity 65%. Fri: 23, Sat: 22, Sun: 22.
 Porreres (9C) 23C, gentle west breeze easing to calm; humidity 65%. Fri: 23, Sat: 21, Sun: 21.
